Delhi Court Takes Cognisance of Chargesheet in NEET Paper Leak Case

A Delhi court has taken cognisance of a CBI chargesheet against 13 individuals in connection with the NEET-UG paper leak case. The court found prima facie evidence of a syndicate involved in the leak. The chargesheet reportedly contains 20,000 pages. Separately, a court rejected a plea by some accused seeking polygraph and brain-mapping tests to prove their innocence. Three individuals, including two doctors, were arrested in Bihar for alleged 'ghostwriting' in the case.
